item.title: What did I do wrong?
item.description:
I'm working on a dataset about movies and I'm new to rstudio.
Scatterplot looks off? Can you tell me what's wrong with it?
merged\_data <- merge(movie\_data, ratings\_export, by = "movie\_id")
filtered\_data <- subset(merged\_data, runtime >= 0 & runtime <= 150 & rating\_val >= 1 & rating\_val <= 10)
plot(filtered\_data$runtime, filtered\_data$rating\_val,
main = "Popularity vs Runtime",
xlab = "Runtime (min)",
ylab = "Rating",
col = "orchid",
pch = 15,
xlim = c(0, 400),
ylim = c(1, 10),
cex = 1.2)
https://preview.redd.it/1w0ytd8zhw7f1.png?width=812&format=png&auto=webp&s=5a766ea527ca38d9018c4eabca4b5de8536f1c34
